title: 1、EXT. BEAUTIFUL HOUSE - FRONT DOOR - DAY
summary: Micky visits his daughter Kasie unannounced, promises better future after his upcoming fight, but Laurie denies access, leading to a brief emotional exchange through the door before she closes it.

title: 2、EXT. MICKY'S APARTMENT ABOVE GARAGE - MORNING - LATER IN THIB
summary: Micky considers Mike Toma's offer to train in Vegas but hesitates due to loyalty to his brother Dicky and family, who express distrust and concern over leaving them behind.

title: 3、EXT. ALICE & GEORGE WARD'S HOUSE - LIMOUSINE (PARKED) -
summary: Charlene mispronounces 'Belle Epoque' and questions its exclusivity to Lexington; Micky confirms it's playing there and heard it's good from a coworker, as they enter the theater.

title: 4、INT. LEXINGTON ART-HOUSE MOVIE THEATER - NIGHT
summary: Four people present; Charlene watches a movie and observes Micky asleep with his head back and mouth open.

title: 5、EXT. LEXINGTON ART-HOUSE MOVIE THEATER - NIGHT
summary: Charlene's presence sparks tension as Alice and Dicky feel disrespected; Micky defends her, seeking paid training, while Dicky offers support to keep the family united.

title: 6、EXT. CRACK HOUSE IN LOWELL - DAYS LATER
summary: A Cambodian man speaks off-screen in Cambodian, followed by Dicky discussing a $200 investment requiring ten other people.

title: 7、INT. CRACK HOUSE IN LOWELL - DAY
summary: Dicky reflects on the fleeting euphoria of crack, followed by a jarring return to reality as the flashback vanishes, leaving him desperate to find money for Micky.

title: 8、EXT. CHARLENE'S YARD - DAY
summary: Micky trains Kasie for high jump; Charlene demonstrates a successful 5'1" jump, landing on pillows. Micky then leaves with Kasie for a business dinner with Nana.

title: 9、EXT. ABANDONED LOWELL CRACK CORNER - NIGHT
summary: Karen, dressed provocatively, approaches a businessman in a Volvo who shows interest after she asks if he wants to date.

title: 10、EXT. SHADOWY DEAD END STREET - NIGHT
summary: A Volvo wagon is parked by the side with its lights off.

title: 11、INT. BUSINESSMAN'S VOLVO STATION WAGON - NIGHT
summary: Dicky, after robbing a businessman, flees on foot when a cop car arrives and a bald businessman identifies him as the perpetrator.

title: 12、INT. OLYMPIA RESTAURANT - DOWNTOWN, LOWELL - NIGHT
summary: Micky, injured and drinking, seeks Charlene's support but is rejected; she criticizes his surrender to family pressures. Dicky endures brutal crack withdrawal in prison. Months later, Micky remains depressed, roofing with friends.

title: 13、INT. ALICE'S HOUSE - 3 WEEKS LATER - HBO PROMO FOR 'HIGH EB
summary: Dicky moves unseen through the dim cafeteria, exits through unlocked metal doors, descending stairs to an unknown area below, continuing his solitary, ghost-like journey within the facility.

title: 14、INT. TRAP, 1ST FLOOR - B.H.C. - NIGHT
summary: Alice watches a documentary with family, upset over Dicky's situation; Micky, emotional and conflicted, reconnects with Charlene, spends the night together, then leaves early with boxing gear.

title: 15、EXT. MICKY'S 2ND FLOOR APT. PORCH - CONTINUOUS
summary: Micky decides to meet a man from George with a cab company, leaves, and Charlene watches him go from the balcony.

title: 16、EXT. LOWELL STREET NEARY MICKY'S - DAY
summary: Micky expresses conflicted emotions, showing relief at Dicky's recovery but lingering pain and regret, ending with a silent nod before leaving.

title: 17、INT. GYM - CONTINUOUS
summary: Dicky leaves the gym after a confrontation, ignoring George's pleas to return; he walks through Lowell as people recognize him, while George worries about his intentions.

title: 18、EXT. CRACK STREET - CONTINUOUS
summary: Micky wins, celebrated by Dicky, Charlene, and Alice; brothers honored as champions. Micky retires in 2003 after fights with Gatti; Dicky stays sober, trains fighters. Micky marries Charlene, lives in Lowell with family.
